item.title: Connect other services to Murph
item.summary: In Settings, under Services, paste the link a service gives for AI assistants (an MCP server). Murph signs in if the service asks, you choose what Murph may look up, and Murph can then use it in your private chats and check-ins.
item.details: For now Murph can only look things up; actions that change things stay off. Every action starts off, and if a service changes one, Murph waits until you look at it again. Removing a service signs Murph out of it. Services never reach group chats.
